constraints.name: Session_nonnegative_check
constraints.expression: "revision" >= 0 AND "activeMessageCount" >= 0 AND "artifactCount" >= 0 AND "filesRevision" >= 0 AND "createdAtMs" >= 0 AND "updatedAtMs" >= 0 AND ("archivedAtMs" IS NULL OR "archivedAtMs" >= 0) AND ("presentedActivityAtMs" IS NULL OR "presentedActivityAtMs" >= 0) AND ("sourceByteLength" IS NULL OR "sourceByteLength" >= 0) AND ("sourceMtimeMs" IS NULL OR "sourceMtimeMs" >= 0) AND ("deletedAtMs" IS NULL OR "deletedAtMs" >= 0)

constraints.name: SessionModelCallUsage_identity_check
constraints.expression: length(trim("messageId")) > 0 AND length(trim("callId")) > 0 AND "callIndex" >= 0 AND ("sourceInvocationId" IS NULL OR length(trim("sourceInvocationId")) > 0) AND ("frameworkId" IS NULL OR length(trim("frameworkId")) > 0) AND ("backendId" IS NULL OR length(trim("backendId")) > 0) AND ("model" IS NULL OR length(trim("model")) > 0)

constraints.name: SessionModelCallUsage_nonnegative_check
constraints.expression: "inputTokens" >= 0 AND "cacheTokens" >= 0 AND "outputTokens" >= 0 AND (("cachedReadTokens" IS NULL AND "cachedWriteTokens" IS NULL) OR ("cachedReadTokens" IS NOT NULL AND "cachedWriteTokens" IS NOT NULL AND "cachedReadTokens" >= 0 AND "cachedWriteTokens" >= 0)) AND ("contextUsedTokens" IS NULL OR "contextUsedTokens" >= 0) AND ("contextWindowSize" IS NULL OR "contextWindowSize" > 0)

constraints.name: SessionAuxiliaryTurnUsage_identity_check
constraints.expression: length(trim("sessionId")) > 0 AND length(trim("eventId")) > 0 AND length(trim("frameworkId")) > 0 AND ("model" IS NULL OR length(trim("model")) > 0)

constraints.name: SessionAuxiliaryTurnUsage_nonnegative_check
constraints.expression: "completedAtMs" >= 0 AND "inputTokens" >= 0 AND "cacheTokens" >= 0 AND "outputTokens" >= 0 AND (("cachedReadTokens" IS NULL AND "cachedWriteTokens" IS NULL) OR ("cachedReadTokens" IS NOT NULL AND "cachedWriteTokens" IS NOT NULL AND "cachedReadTokens" >= 0 AND "cachedWriteTokens" >= 0)) AND ("modelCallCount" IS NULL OR "modelCallCount" > 0)

constraints.name: Tag_shape_check
constraints.expression: (("systemKey" IS NOT NULL AND "name" IS NULL AND "nameKey" IS NULL AND "iconKey" IS NULL AND "colorKey" IS NULL) OR ("systemKey" IS NULL AND "name" IS NOT NULL AND "nameKey" IS NOT NULL AND "iconKey" IS NOT NULL AND "colorKey" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: NotificationInboxItem_actionLifecycle_check
constraints.expression: (("actionState" IS NULL AND "settledAt" IS NULL) OR ("actionState" IS NOT NULL AND (("actionState" = 'pending' AND "settledAt" IS NULL) OR ("actionState" IN ('resolved', 'rejected', 'expired', 'cancelled') AND "settledAt" IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: NotificationInboxItem_targetInvalidated_check
constraints.expression: "targetInvalidatedAt" IS NULL OR ("sessionId" IS NOT NULL AND "readAt" IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: PermissionGrant_qualifier_check
constraints.expression: (("qualifierMode" IN ('none', 'any') AND "qualifierValue" IS NULL) OR ("qualifierMode" IN ('category', 'exact') AND "qualifierValue" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("qualifierValue")) > 0))

constraints.name: PermissionGrant_scope_check
constraints.expression: (("scopeKind" = 'global' AND "projectId" IS NULL AND "sessionId" IS NULL) OR ("scopeKind" = 'project' AND "projectId" IS NOT NULL AND "sessionId" IS NULL) OR ("scopeKind" = 'session' AND "projectId" IS NOT NULL AND "sessionId" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: FileOriginSession_lifecycle_check
constraints.expression: (("state" = 'active' AND "deletedAt" IS NULL AND "deletionOperationId" IS NULL AND "retainedReviewIdsJson" IS NULL) OR ("state" = 'deleting' AND "deletedAt" IS NULL AND "deletionOperationId" IS NOT NULL AND "retainedReviewIdsJson" IS NOT NULL) OR ("state" = 'deleted' AND "deletedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "deletionOperationId" IS NULL AND "retainedReviewIdsJson" IS NULL))

constraints.name: UploadVersion_userEdit_check
constraints.expression: ("originKind" <> 'user_edit' OR ("state" = 'ready' AND "basedOnVersionId" IS NOT NULL AND "storageTag" IS NOT NULL AND "storedFilename" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: ArtifactVersion_provenance_check
constraints.expression: (("originKind" = 'agent_generated' AND "artifactRunId" IS NOT NULL AND "rootFrameId" IS NOT NULL AND "agentFrameId" IS NOT NULL AND "messageBranchId" IS NOT NULL AND "runtimeSegmentId" IS NOT NULL AND "promptMessageId" IS NOT NULL AND "evidenceStorageKey" IS NOT NULL AND "evidenceJson" IS NOT NULL AND "evidenceChecksum" IS NOT NULL AND "evidenceSchemaVersion" IS NOT NULL) OR ("originKind" = 'user_edit' AND "state" = 'finalized' AND "basedOnVersionId" IS NOT NULL AND "storageTag" IS NOT NULL AND "storedFilename" IS NOT NULL AND "artifactRunId" IS NULL AND "writeRequestChecksum" IS NULL AND "rootFrameId" IS NULL AND "agentFrameId" IS NULL AND "messageBranchId" IS NULL AND "runtimeSegmentId" IS NULL AND "promptMessageId" IS NULL AND "notebookSessionId" IS NULL AND "producerRunId" IS NULL AND "producerRunIndex" IS NULL AND "messageId" IS NULL AND "messageSnapshotId" IS NULL AND "evidenceStorageKey" IS NULL AND "evidenceJson" IS NULL AND "evidenceChecksum" IS NULL AND "evidenceSchemaVersion" IS NULL AND "executionSnapshotJson" IS NULL AND "executionSnapshotChecksum" IS NULL AND "executionSnapshotStorageKey" IS NULL AND "executionSnapshotSchemaVersion" IS NULL) OR "originKind" = 'legacy')

constraints.name: ArtifactVersion_executionSnapshotBundle_check
constraints.expression: (("executionSnapshotJson" IS NULL AND "executionSnapshotChecksum" IS NULL AND "executionSnapshotStorageKey" IS NULL AND "executionSnapshotSchemaVersion" IS NULL) OR ("executionSnapshotJson" IS NOT NULL AND "executionSnapshotChecksum" IS NOT NULL AND "executionSnapshotStorageKey" IS NOT NULL AND "executionSnapshotSchemaVersion" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: ArtifactVersionInput_sourceIdentity_check
constraints.expression: (("sourceKind" = 'artifact-version' AND "sourceArtifactVersionId" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceUploadVersionId" IS NULL AND "inputFileVersionId" = "sourceArtifactVersionId") OR ("sourceKind" = 'upload-version' AND "sourceArtifactVersionId" IS NULL AND "sourceUploadVersionId" IS NOT NULL AND "inputFileVersionId" = "sourceUploadVersionId"))

constraints.name: Review_state_check
constraints.expression: (("lifecycle" = 'running' AND "outcome" IS NULL AND "errorMessage" IS NULL) OR ("lifecycle" = 'complete' AND "outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "errorMessage" IS NULL) OR ("lifecycle" = 'error' AND "outcome" IS NULL AND "errorMessage" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: ReviewFindingDisposition_state_check
constraints.expression: (("trigger" = 'review_submission' AND "causeReviewId" IS NOT NULL AND "outcome" IN ('still_open', 'resolved')) OR ("trigger" IN ('loop_terminated', 'correction_failed', 'aborted') AND "causeReviewId" IS NULL AND "outcome" = 'unaddressed'))

constraints.name: ComputeJob_notification_check
constraints.expression: "notificationConsumedAt" IS NULL OR "notifiedAt" IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: ComputeJob_analysisBundle_check
constraints.expression: (("analysisState" IS NULL AND "analysisMessageId" IS NULL AND "analysisUpdatedAt" IS NULL) OR ("analysisState" IS NOT NULL AND "analysisMessageId" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("analysisMessageId")) > 0 AND "analysisUpdatedAt" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: ComputeJob_analysisConsumption_check
constraints.expression: "analysisState" IS NULL OR "analysisState" <> 'succeeded' OR "notificationConsumedAt" IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: ComputeJob_harvestPayload_check
constraints.expression: ("harvestError" IS NULL AND "leftOnRemote" IS NULL) OR "harvestedAt" IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: ComputeJob_errorState_check
constraints.expression: (("errorCode" IS NULL OR "status" IN ('failed', 'timeout', 'error')) AND ("status" <> 'error' OR "errorCode" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: ComputeHost_detailsUpdate_check
constraints.expression: ("detailsUpdatedAt" IS NULL AND "detailsUpdatedBy" IS NULL) OR ("detailsUpdatedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "detailsUpdatedBy" IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: VisionEvidence_sourceIdentity_check
constraints.expression: (("sourceKind" = 'upload-version' AND "uploadVersionId" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceMessageId" IS NULL AND "sourceImageId" IS NULL) OR ("sourceKind" = 'message-image' AND "uploadVersionId" IS NULL AND "sourceMessageId" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceImageId" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: ComputeJobOperation_lifecycle_check
constraints.expression: ("phase" = 'active' AND "outcome" IS NULL AND "settledAt" IS NULL) OR ("phase" = 'settled' AND "outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "outcome" IN ('fulfilled', 'superseded') AND "settledAt" IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ComputeJobOperation_claim_check
constraints.expression: ("claimToken" IS NULL AND "claimExpiresAt" IS NULL) OR ("phase" = 'active' AND "claimToken" IS NOT NULL AND "claimExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ComputeJobOperation_settled_implementation_check
constraints.expression: "phase" = 'active' OR ("eligibleAt" IS NULL AND "claimToken" IS NULL AND "claimExpiresAt" IS NULL)

constraints.name: MemoryCategory_shape_check
constraints.expression: (("systemKey" IS NOT NULL AND "systemKey" = 'about-you' AND "name" IS NULL AND "nameKey" IS NULL AND "guidance" = '' AND "autoRecall" = true) OR ("systemKey" IS NULL AND "name" IS NOT NULL AND "nameKey" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: MemoryCategory_name_check
constraints.expression: "name" IS NULL OR length(trim("name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 64

constraints.name: MemoryCategory_nameKey_check
constraints.expression: "nameKey" IS NULL OR length("nameKey") BETWEEN 1 AND 64

constraints.name: MemoryEntry_scope_check
constraints.expression: "categoryId" IS NOT NULL OR "projectId" IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: MemoryEntry_source_check
constraints.expression: ("origin" = 'user' AND "sourceSessionId" IS NULL AND "sourceAgentId" IS NULL) OR ("origin" = 'agent' AND "sourceSessionId" IS NOT NULL AND "projectId" IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: MemoryEntry_global_contentKey_key
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "MemoryEntry_global_contentKey_key" ON "MemoryEntry"("contentKey") WHERE "projectId" IS NULL
